category.name: Join Documents
category.preferred_workflow: Create all source documents in the sample code, load the destination document, locate the target bookmark or node, use DocumentBuilder.InsertDocument or Document.AppendDocument with an explicit ImportFormatMode, remove any protection if needed, save the result in the desired format, and finally verify that the output file exists and contains the expected inserted text.

strict_api_bans: Never assume that source files or folders already exist; always generate them within the example.
Do not call non-existent Aspose.Words methods such as InsertDocument on MailMerge or use invented join APIs.
Never insert a node into an invalid parent container or append a node to itself.
canonical_patterns: Use DocumentBuilder.MoveToBookmark followed by InsertDocument for precise bookmark insertion.
Use Document.AppendDocument for whole-document concatenation and always specify ImportFormatMode.
When performing find-replace insertion, employ FindReplaceOptions with a custom IReplacingCallback that imports nodes via NodeImporter.
nullable_warning_prevention: Initialize all non-nullable reference-type fields and locals to avoid CS8618 warnings.
Guard any potentially null values with explicit null checks before dereferencing.
Declare variables as nullable only when a null value is a legitimate state and handle that case safely.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: The example fails to compile because it references source DOCX files that were never created.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The code assumes external files exist without generating them in the sample.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Create the required source documents programmatically before attempting to load or join them.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Always include document creation steps at the start of the sample.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: Compilation errors occur when the code calls unsupported methods or uses AppendDocument where InsertDocument is required.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The developer selected an API that does not match the intended operation (e.g., whole-document append vs. bookmark insertion).
common_failure_patterns.fix: Use AppendDocument for full-document concatenation and InsertDocument (or InsertDocumentInline) only when inserting at a specific location.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Map the desired join scenario to the correct Aspose.Words API before coding.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: Runtime exceptions indicate that a node of an unsupported type was inserted into a header, footer, or other invalid container.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The code attempts to insert a Section or Body node directly into a Paragraph or Header node.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Import only compatible node types (e.g., Paragraph, Run, Table) and insert them into a valid parent such as a Paragraph or Section.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Validate the target container's NodeType before performing InsertAfter/InsertBefore operations.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: Build failures arise from using string overloads of Range.Replace with a document object, and runtime errors occur when the callback inserts nodes incorrectly.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The sample treats a document as a replacement string instead of using a ReplacingCallback that imports nodes.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Configure FindReplaceOptions.ReplacingCallback to import nodes via NodeImporter and replace the placeholder run, then remove the placeholder paragraph.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Never pass a Document to the string-based Replace method; always use a callback for document insertion.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: Compilation errors show that MailMerge.InsertDocument does not exist, and runtime checks report missing sections after merge.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The code references a non-existent InsertDocument event on MailMerge and does not correctly combine generated documents.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Perform mail merge on a template, then append or insert the additional document using DocumentBuilder.InsertDocument within a FieldMergingCallback, or concatenate results with AppendDocument.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Use the documented MailMerge.FieldMergingCallback pattern and combine documents with AppendDocument after each merge iteration.

narrative.overview: The Join Documents category demonstrates how to combine Word processing files using Aspose.Words 26.11.0 while preserving formatting, bookmarks, and protection settings. Verified examples cover insertion at bookmarks, password-protected documents, header/footer insertion, find-replace callbacks, and mail-merge driven document injection.
narrative.purpose: Provide an AI coding assistant with clear, reproducible patterns for safely joining, inserting, and appending documents in Aspose.Words, ensuring that all required resources are created locally, APIs are used correctly, and the merged output is validated for expected content.
validation_priorities: After each join operation, confirm that the output file exists and that its text includes a unique marker from every source document.
maintenance_notes: Keep the sample code aligned with the current Aspose.Words API surface; update namespace imports and method signatures whenever a new version is released.
